propositions: CodeQL workflow was running on weekly cron (23 4 * * 1) after push-on-main trigger was removed, making the weekly schedule the primary scan rather than a backstop, leaving newly-introduced findings unscanned for up to 7 days
CodeQL should be moved to the 6-hourly cron (35 */6 * * *) to restore the intended coverage frequency that push-on-main previously provided, reducing worst-case exposure to 6 hours

The stale header comment in codeql.yml asserting a 28x cost increase and deliberate exclusion from 6-hourly cadence is contradicted by the fact that navapbc/rebar is a public repository where CodeQL and GitHub Actions minutes are free
Four branch-health lanes (test, optionality, verify-identity, codeql) must use distinct off-the-hour cron minutes (41, 47, 53, 35 respectively) to avoid congestion at the hour boundary

Test coverage in test_ci_main_push_policy.py must be retargeted to pin the new 6-hourly cadence for CodeQL while preserving assertions that CodeQL has no push trigger to main and retains workflow_dispatch
